install: touch ~/.bashrc && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true) && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc) && if [ -n "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" ]; then python3 -m pip install --no-input kaggle requests; else python3 -m pip install --user --no-input kaggle requests; fi
